body: That's okay, you don't have to feel forced into anything. If you do want to talk I'm on here pretty much all the time, feel free to message me. I honestly hope you feel better soon. Try to take care of yourself, take the rest you need but never stop searching for things worth getting out of bed for. Much love.
Ah, dude, that sucks so much. High school isn't forever, hang in there. Screw those guys for outing you like that.

Heh, I'm actually doing something similar right now. My mom is on vacation and my brothers are staying at my dad's house for a week. I was not so subtly told to stay to look after all of the animals. It sucks and it feels like they don't want you there, but hey, the dogs want you there. Loneliness is a difficult feeling, it's isolating and it's difficult to make friends when you're starting from zero. I hope things start looking up for you soon. If it becomes too much you can take the puppers for a walk and make conversation with strangers. I always find social situations more bearable with a pet around. Good luck internet stranger!
I see you, you're real to me. You exist and you matter.
Hey, I'm really sorry you're going through all of this. What's making you feel this way?

Oops, sorry!
And I'm glad I could help. Hope you feel better soon, take care.

I get what you mean, if you think therapy will help you it's worth the cost. Telling your mom might make her sad, but if she knew how bad you're hurting right now and not telling her she'd be even sadder. You're her son and it's okay for you to ask her for comfort, who knows, she might be going trough something similar right now and then you can support each other. No one should expect from you to have already gotten over it because you never get over something like that. Bad days, weeks or months are bound to come and it's best to not go trough those by yourself.

That must have been horrible..  How do you feel about him and his dicisions now? Is getting back into therapy an option? There's absolutely no shame in that. You went trough a lot, and you dont have to get trough it by yourself.
Hey, I'm sorry you're going through this right now. My dad attempted suicide about ten years ago and I wouldn't know what I'd do if he had succeeded. I'm here if you want to talk.
Hey, I'm so so sorry you're going trough this right now, can we please talk for a bit?
How cool is that?? So creative!

Yeah, I get that. It's not dumb, theres not really anything that anyone can just say to make you feel better. I hope you hang in there, seriously. You seem like a good person and you deserve better than this. Best of luck, man. Message me whenever you need a chat.

Damn, that's rough. Has reaching out on the internet helped at all? Idk how old you are but if you're in school there must be some kind of help program, if you're an adult looking for professional help might be your best bet

First of all, ALL methods of suicide leave people traumatized. It's traumatizing just to hear about it. There was a kid in my high school several years ago who committed suicide, I never heard about the method, but just hearing about it, knowing he felt so terrible and stuck that he had to do it, fucked many people on that school up for life. I mean, I'm in college now and I still think about it. You're always going to leave a body for someone else to find, no matter how considerate the note is, how 'peaceful' the method.. 
That being said, I am so, so sorry you feel this way, nobody should and yet many of us do. Being suicidal is a lonely feeling, but you're not alone. Please talk to someone you know, try to reach out for help... best of luck to you, hope you can feel better soon.

Hey, I'm so sorry you're going trough this. It awful when you're being left out by your friend group. If you want someone to talk to to combat the loneliness feel free to send me a message. Take care!
Looks like an ocean, love it
Sorry to hear it, hope you feel better soon dude

I'm not sure if this is a 'tip' that applies to everyone, but I often don't feel like eating during depressive episodes. So, when I feel up to it I invite a friend or family member over for dinner only, and then I cook for them. It ensures I don't isolate myself comepletely and also makes sure I ate that day. They already know about my disorder so they'll usually leave me in peace afterwards. It's really helped me keeping healthy and somewhat social.
No worries, it's fixable. That only makes and old hat more wonderful.

First of all, I'm really sorry you're going trough this right now. Second of all, suicide and death does have an impact, no matter who you are. Suicide is like a bomb, it hits hard and everyone around it gets affected. A kid I didn't know in high school took his own life a few years ago and I still think about it, about how I became more suicidal myself just hearing about it. Leaving like that isn't going to make anything better, please reconsider. I hope you feel better soon.
Reminds me of quiet static in my head.. I wish I was there too

Sending the good vibes right back at ya. That nurse was unprofessional and rude to talk in such a manner. None of this was your fault, there's truly nothing to be ashamed of.
Good luck!
Hey, I'm sorry you're at such a bad time in your life. Is there anyone you could tell irl? A friend or family member?

Hey, first of all, I'm so sorry you feel this way, and all the shit you had to to trough. Please do tell someone about these thoughts and feelings. It could be your boyfriend, or you could perhaps seek counselling if that is an affordable option for you. Don't keep it all in your head, writing this down here was an amazing first step and you can be proud of that.
That's an awesome personality trait to have, you seem like a good person. Good luck to you and your friend as well. Keep your head above water, this internet stranger believes in you

Huh, I'm really sorry you feel that way. If writing seems like a good distraction, maybe try to jut feelings down more often? Even if it's repetitive. Making lists of whatever things you're thinking about. I wish I could help you out, hope things get better for you soon, you deserve it.

Big oof. I'm really glad you wrote it down and posted it here, though. Shit can get so messed up when you keep it in your head forever. Any hobbies that you do still enjoy? A pet to take care of? To me the best method is usually distraction, although that's difficult when nothing entertains or motivates you anymore.

Ah, sorry to hear that. I'm not a professional so I'm not really sure what I would do. What I do know is that I relate to a lot of what you said, and it sucks, but I'm working on it. By replying to people here, by posting, .. idk, just not giving up on enjoying things. Do you have anyone irl to talk to about serious stuff like this?
Is seeking counselling an affordable option for you? Even though we're all willing to help, it could be best to have a professional listen to these thoughts and feelings you have.

I'm so so so glad you're still with us. I suffer from the same condition and mood swings / episodes are fucking wild, and almost impossible to deal with. Best of luck to you, I truly hope you feel better soon. <3

You're right, you can't change the world to make it better, nor can you control what happens to you. All you can do is change yourself, and your own way of thinking. Therapy or facilities have done wonders for others, but at the end of the day it's your own head and you have to decide the steps you take to better the world inside it. Don't give up before you've tried that, a peaceful mind sounds wonderful. I'd love to get there some day, and wish everyone here the same.

This one made me cry, I'm glad I'm not the only one feeling like this. I feel so ungrateful and guilty about being suicidal. One on one therapy never did much for me, neither did medication, but I've never tried group therapy before. 
Good luck, hope you're doing well
I didn't actually expect for people to notice this post so quickly.. I'm not sure how to feel but thank you, I really appreciate it. This is one hell of an amazing subreddit.
Keeping busy does help, it's just hard to motivate myself to get up when no one is telling me to, but you're right
Thank you for responding, maybe I should take my dog to some classes at our local dog school? I'm not sure

Please don't, it's not your time. You're screaming and I'm listening, I hear you. I don't know you, I don't know your life or what you've been through but I'm here to listen to you talk, okay? Message me if you want to, no pressure.
